messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync on the welcome newsletter handoff — want a tight playbook for launch week. Key items: send windows, canary plan, seed list, seg mapping. Who's in?
Ravi Patel: I'll map audiences and build the exclusion list. Dumping trial cohorts + webinar signups into a sheet.
Sam Ortiz: Deliverability here. Will run SPF/DKIM check and a 2k seed send Monday. Need subject lines locked to preview in inbox.
Lena Kowalski: Copy locked for product section. Two subject variants to test: "Welcome to Redwood — Start in minutes" and "Fast, reliable LLM inference — get started". Footer includes webinar invite.
Aaron Blake: Proposed rollout: canary 5% Tue 10am PT, 40% Wed 10am PT, full Thu 9am PT. APAC sends +24h.
Maya Chen: Canary thresholds: pause if bounce_rate > 4% OR hard_bounce > 0.4% in first 60m. Assign monitor?
Sam Ortiz: I'll watch first 60m. ops-bot set alerts: bounce_rate>0.04, hardbounce>0.004, unique_opens<0.18 for canary.
ops-bot: alert rule created for thread 2807654321: bounce_rate>0.04, hardbounce>0.004, unique_opens<0.18; pre-send checks scheduled 30m prior
Ravi Patel: Segs: ["trial_0_7","trial_8_30","webinar_regs","early_access_list"]. Suppress: unsubscribed, gdpr_optout, recent_support. Adding timezone column for stagger. UTM: utm_campaign=welcome_launch_q3
Lena Kowalski: CTA variants: "Start integration" vs "View quickstart". A/B on trial_0_7. Include webinar CTA in footer with date/time localized.
Maya Chen: QA checklist short: seeds, link checks (UTM), image alt text, unsubscribe test, transactional header present.
Sam Ortiz: Seed plan: 60 internal + 50 ISP external + 500 panel addresses. I'll share seedlist by EOD.
Aaron Blake: Send config snippet for ops team:
```
{"send_windows":["2027-09-14T17:00:00Z","2027-09-15T16:00:00Z"],"stagger":"region_based","rollout":[5,40,100]}
```
Maya Chen: Owners recap: Seg mapping = Ravi, Deliverability = Sam, Copy = Lena, Send = Aaron. I'll publish the Notion playbook and ping product-marketing once live. Final QA tomorrow 9am PT.
Ravi Patel: I'll attach the CSV and final sheet link when ready.
Sam Ortiz: Locking subject lines by EOD so previews can be queued.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — ping here for any blockers. :rocket:
